patches.name: Hide archived apps
patches.description: Filters archived apps out of the app drawer, the add-to-home-screen picker, and the shortcut picker.

patches.name: Shizuku app archiving
patches.description: Adds a context menu item to archive apps via Shizuku (`pm archive`) in Smart Launcher 6.

patches.name: Native app archiving
patches.description: Enables system PackageInstaller/LauncherApps native archiving on supported devices (e.g. S22 Ultra with One UI / Android 15+).
